description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called ContextUsageBar, which visually represents the usage of tokens within a context window, displaying a colored bar that changes appearance based on usage percentage.

classes.name: ContextUsageBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a colored bar indicating the proportion of used tokens in a context window, with color intensity based on usage percentage.

methods.name: clampedFractionUsed
methods.description: Calculates the ratio of used tokens to total context tokens, clamped between 0 and 1.

methods.name: percentUsed
methods.description: Returns the percentage of tokens used as an integer, or nil if undefined.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides a string for accessibility labels indicating usage percentage or unknown state.

methods.name: barBody
methods.description: Constructs the visual representation of the usage bar with animated fill based on usage fraction.
